verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a downloadable OpenAPI document at grafana.com/api/openapi.json. It returned HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key, so the vendor publishes a machine-readable API spec an AI-native user can fetch directly. The evidence is a single probe, though: no first-party docs describe the spec, its scope or its versioning. The URL also leaves unclear whether it covers the Grafana instance HTTP API or the Grafana.com service API. missing for 10: documentation describing the spec's coverage and versioning, confirmation that it covers the core Grafana HTTP API, independent or hands-on corroboration of its completeness

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://grafana.com/api/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
